mitmweb now inserts new live flows at the top when `view_order_reversed` is set. I didn't write this: the working tree already held the complete change when I looked, as uncommitted edits. I read through it, and it matches your description. I haven't run `npm test` or any other tests.

  - `FlowsState` gains a `viewOrderReversed` field, defaulting to `false`.
  - `OPTIONS_RECEIVE` and `OPTIONS_UPDATE` set it from the `view_order_reversed` option. An update that doesn't include that option returns the same state object.
  - The other flow actions carry the field through unchanged.
  - On `FLOWS_ADD`, a flow goes to the front when there is no column sort and the option is on. Otherwise it goes through the normal sorted insert, so an active column sort still wins.

  - reading the option from `OPTIONS_RECEIVE` and `OPTIONS_UPDATE`;
  - front insertion when reversed;
  - back insertion when not reversed;
  - an active column sort taking precedence.

Only `FLOWS_ADD` uses the new ordering, as you specified. The `FLOWS_UPDATE` path that re-inserts a flow into the view, and the order restored when a column sort is turned off, are unchanged.
